## Common WHERE Filters

### 标准分区与时区过滤 (Standard Filters)

```sql
-- Used in 100% of queries
WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND user_id > 0
```

### 事件类型过滤

```sql
-- 曝光和点击
AND operation in ('impression', 'click')

-- 仅 item 级事件
AND target_type = 'item'

-- 或: Homepage Daily Discover
AND (target_type = 'item' OR (business_line = 'Homepage' AND module = 'Daily Discover'))
```

### 广告/自然流量分流

```sql
-- 广告流量
AND common_property.is_ads = true

-- 自然流量
AND (common_property.is_ads != true OR common_property.is_ads IS NULL)

-- 三步归因的 ads 判断
AND (common_property.is_ads OR source1.common_property.is_ads OR source2.common_property.is_ads)
```

### 图片搜索场景

```sql
AND feature_detail LIKE 'image_search-%'
AND search_property.image_source IN (
    'DD_rcmd', 'PDP_FS', 'PDP_YMAL', 'SEARCH_RESULT_CARD',
    'camera', 'discover', 'find_similar', 'gallery_panel',
    'recently_view', 'recently_viewed', 'search_history'
)
```

### 时间范围过滤

```sql
-- 日期范围 (Seller Report)
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${grass_date_start}') AND date('${grass_date_end}')
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### Self-Join: 多步归因 (Multi-Step Attribution)

本表最核心的 pattern：通过 step_type (step0/step1/step2/stepall) UNION ALL + self-join 实现多触点归因。

```sql
-- Step 0: 从原始事件直接判断 is_ads
SELECT 'step0' AS step_type, ...,
    CASE WHEN (feature_detail LIKE '%-shop_item' AND feature_group = 'Search')
         THEN source1.common_property.is_ads
         ELSE common_property.is_ads
    END AS is_ads
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local' AND user_id > 0
  AND operation IN ('impression', 'click')

UNION ALL

-- Step 1: 从 source1 获取上一步归因
SELECT 'step1' AS step_type, ...,
    source1.common_property.is_ads AS is_ads
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE ...

UNION ALL

-- Step 2: 从 source2 获取再上一步归因
SELECT 'step2' AS step_type, ...,
    source2.common_property.is_ads AS is_ads
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE ...

UNION ALL

-- Step All: 任意步有 ads 即算 ads
SELECT 'stepall' AS step_type, ...,
    (common_property.is_ads OR source1.common_property.is_ads OR source2.common_property.is_ads) AS is_ads
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE ...
```

## Common Aggregations

### Item 级别曝光/点击计数 (ads vs organic 分流)

```sql
-- 最核心的聚合 pattern
SELECT
    grass_region, user_id, common_feature, app_version, item_id, location, shop_id, entry_point,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads = true AND operation = 'impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_item_impr_ads_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (is_ads != true OR is_ads IS NULL) AND operation = 'impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_item_impr_organic_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_item_impr_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads = true AND operation = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_item_click_ads_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (is_ads != true OR is_ads IS NULL) AND operation = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_item_click_organic_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_item_click_cnt
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local' AND user_id > 0
  AND operation IN ('impression', 'click')
GROUP BY grass_region, user_id, common_feature, app_version, item_id, location, shop_id, entry_point, ...
```

### 平台级别聚合 (Live Ads Tracker)

```sql
-- 简化版: 平台级 imp/click/DAU
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS platform_imp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS platform_click,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN operation = 'impression' AND target_type = 'item' THEN user_id END) AS platform_dau
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local' AND user_id > 0
  AND operation IN ('impression', 'click')
  AND (target_type = 'item' OR (business_line = 'Homepage' AND module = 'Daily Discover'))
```

### Seller Report 维度聚合

```sql
-- 按 shop + business_line + module/object/feature 维度聚合
SELECT
    grass_date, grass_region, shop_id, business_line, module, object, feature_group, feature, feature_detail,
    SUM(IF(operation = 'impression', 1, 0)) AS total_impression_cnt,
    SUM(IF(operation = 'click', 1, 0)) AS total_click_cnt,
    SUM(IF(operation = 'impression' AND common_property.is_ads = true, 1, 0)) AS total_ads_impression_cnt,
    SUM(IF(operation = 'click' AND common_property.is_ads = true, 1, 0)) AS total_ads_click_cnt
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${grass_date_start}') AND date('${grass_date_end}')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: Omni Organic Metrics -- Item 级别 imp/click 多步归因 (core workflow)

```sql
-- Step 0/1/2/stepall union all 后聚合
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW omni_item_operation_base AS
SELECT step_type, grass_region, user_id, common_feature, ..., entry_point,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads = true AND operation='impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_item_impr_ads_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (is_ads != true OR is_ads IS NULL) AND operation='impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_item_impr_organic_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN operation='impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_item_impr_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads = true AND operation='click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_item_click_ads_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (is_ads != true OR is_ads IS NULL) AND operation='click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_item_click_organic_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN operation='click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS omni_item_click_cnt
FROM (
    SELECT 'step0' AS step_type, operation, grass_region, user_id, shop_id,
        CASE WHEN (feature_detail LIKE '%-shop_item' AND feature_group = 'Search')
             THEN source1.common_property.is_ads
             ELSE common_property.is_ads END AS is_ads,
        ..., CASE ... END AS common_feature, CASE ... END AS entry_point
    FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
    WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}') AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND tz_type = 'local' AND user_id > 0 AND operation IN ('impression', 'click')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'step1' AS step_type, ..., source1.common_property.is_ads AS is_ads, ...
    FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
    WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}') AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND tz_type = 'local' AND user_id > 0 AND operation IN ('impression', 'click')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'step2' AS step_type, ..., source2.common_property.is_ads AS is_ads, ...
    FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
    WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}') AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND tz_type = 'local' AND user_id > 0 AND operation IN ('impression', 'click')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'stepall' AS step_type, ...,
        (common_property.is_ads OR source1.common_property.is_ads OR source2.common_property.is_ads) AS is_ads, ...
    FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
    WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}') AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND tz_type = 'local' AND user_id > 0 AND operation IN ('impression', 'click')
)
GROUP BY step_type, grass_region, user_id, common_feature, ..., entry_point, ...
```

### Snippet 3: Seller Report -- 按 shop 多维度聚合流量

```sql
CACHE TABLE traffic AS
SELECT
    grass_date, grass_region, shop_id, business_line, module, object, feature_group, feature, feature_detail,
    SUM(IF(operation = 'impression', 1, 0)) AS total_impression_cnt,
    SUM(IF(operation = 'click', 1, 0)) AS total_click_cnt,
    SUM(IF(operation = 'impression' AND common_property.is_ads = true, 1, 0)) AS total_ads_impression_cnt,
    SUM(IF(operation = 'click' AND common_property.is_ads = true, 1, 0)) AS total_ads_click_cnt
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${grass_date_start}') AND date('${grass_date_end}')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9
```

### Snippet 4: Image Search -- 过滤图片搜索事件

```sql
SELECT
    a.user_id, a.operation, a.event_type, a.item_id, a.event_timestamp,
    CASE WHEN (common_property.is_ads = true OR source1.common_property.is_ads = true OR source2.common_property.is_ads = true)
         THEN true ELSE false END AS is_ads,
    location_property.location AS location
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_item_event_log_di__reg_sensitive_live a
WHERE a.grass_date > date('${grass_date}')
  AND a.grass_region IN ('ID')
  AND feature_detail LIKE 'image_search-%'
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND event_type IN ('click', 'impression')
  AND a.user_id IS NOT NULL AND a.user_id != 0
```

### Snippet 5: CASE-WHEN 映射 -- 入口点识别 (Entry Point / Common Feature)

```sql
-- common_feature mapping (used in 10+ files)
CASE
    WHEN module = 'Global Search' THEN 'Global Search'
    WHEN module = 'Image Search' THEN 'Image Search'
    WHEN feature_group = 'You May Also Like' THEN 'You May Also Like'
    WHEN feature_group = 'Live Streaming' THEN 'Live Streaming'
    WHEN feature_group = 'Order Successful Recommendation' THEN 'Order Successful Recommendation'
    WHEN feature_group = 'Cart Recommendation' THEN 'Cart Recommendation'
    WHEN feature = 'mpp_ymal-order_list' THEN 'My Purchase Page Recommendation'
    WHEN feature = 'odp_ymal-order_detail' THEN 'Order Detail Page Recommendation'
    WHEN module = 'Daily Discover' THEN 'Daily Discover'
    WHEN feature_group = 'Video' THEN 'Video'
    WHEN feature_group = 'Games' THEN 'Games'
    WHEN feature = 'voucher-voucher_landing' THEN 'Voucher Landing Recommendation'
    WHEN feature = 'crm_omni_attri-hot_deals_landing' THEN 'Hot Deals Landing Recommendation'
    WHEN feature_detail = 'shop-you_may_also_like-item' THEN 'Shop YMAL'
    ELSE 'Others'
END AS common_feature
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

以下指标在 2+ 个文件中通过 CASE-WHEN + SUM 派生，可视为该表的事实上的业务指标：

| Derived Metric | Formula | Used In |
|----------------|---------|---------|
| omni_item_impr_ads_cnt | `SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads=true AND operation='impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)` | Organic Metrics, AB Test |
| omni_item_impr_organic_cnt | `SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_ads AND operation='impression' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)` | Organic Metrics, AB Test |
| omni_item_click_ads_cnt | `SUM(CASE WHEN is_ads=true AND operation='click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)` | Organic Metrics, AB Test |
| omni_item_click_organic_cnt | `SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_ads AND operation='click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)` | Organic Metrics, AB Test |
| total_ads_impression_cnt | `SUM(IF(operation='impression' AND common_property.is_ads=true, 1, 0))` | Seller Reports |
| total_ads_click_cnt | `SUM(IF(operation='click' AND common_property.is_ads=true, 1, 0))` | Seller Reports |
| platform_dau | `COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN operation='impression' AND target_type='item' THEN user_id END)` | Live Ads Tracker |
